reason: The monoclinic cell and Z=2 are strongly supported (all 19 indexing lines assigned, M(19)=127.9, and extensive peak-position agreement), and the Ga/N/F prototype framework is chemically plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: the comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable; the trajectory never performed or reported a comparable whole-pattern refinement; nearly all non-lattice coordinates were copied from a transformed orthorhombic COD prototype rather than refined against this pattern; and the submitted P1 labels are not the intrinsic symmetries of the coordinates (selected is detected as C2/m and alternative-1 as P2/m). The two files differ only in a limited H-orientation choice, while hydrogen ordering is weakly constrained by Cu X-ray data and the trace did not enumerate or compare the broader discrete ordering possibilities. The inherited N-H distances are also very short (about 0.80-0.85 angstrom). Thus the evidence establishes the cell and average framework much better than the exact symmetry, coordinates, and ordered hydrogen realization, and a symmetry-aware coordinate/profile refinement plus systematic ordering comparison could plausibly produce a materially better candidate set.
